description: This file contains core logic for applying patches to files, including classes, interfaces, and functions for computing and applying text replacements based on parsed hunks, as well as handling file changes such as add, delete, and update.

classes.name: ApplyPatchError
classes.description: Custom error class for errors during patch application.

methods.name: applyChunksToContent
methods.description: Applies a series of update chunks to the original file content, returning the new content.

methods.name: processHunk
methods.description: Processes a single patch hunk to produce a file change (add, delete, update).

methods.name: processAllHunks
methods.description: Processes multiple hunks to produce an array of file changes.
